method: closing critic:monsters, fighter-review method (as monsters-1). Sheet: art/renders/units/<id>.png (three.js, built by art/blender/units/creatures[_b].py). In game: node _harness/value_probe.mjs --maps rift --tiers high --monsters only --t 70|370 --monsterIds <ids> --report fw_CW4_monsters2.json (RIFT, 1920x1080, 28.5 m, fog off) -> _harness/_reports/fw_CW4_monsters2.json, shots _harness/_shots/value_rift_high_<tag>_mon_<id>.png. Metrics as in glasshorn/_review.json.
gate: hp >= the lane's hp (1.18-1.19) and breakup >= 6 where the faces allow; |dL*| >= 20 against the camp floor; L* p90 <= 86; no horror/face read; sensitivity: no tall/pointed hood

before.read: a dark umber bear-like hide (#544234) under amber plates: the hide sank into the dark camp flagstone; only the plates read

changes: pale silver-grey bark coat (#BEB29B) with staggered dark lenticel dashes over flanks and haunches (birch bark): the amber plates now sit on it like resin weeping from a trunk
plate rims lifted from #6A2C0A to #964A1A, mid #BE6A1E; legs/paws stay dark umber
horrorFaceRead: a natural broad-muzzled beast, dark nose and small dark eyes; no horror read

round2.note: Faces the camera three-quarter now (camp facing 60 / 120), so the amber plates and bark coat read at once and it no longer shares an outline with Stilltusk.
